title: Nixon's filing-cabinet folder of alien body photographs

tellings.quote: that story is true. And there was a story that that he had folders. He had a folder in his filing cabinet with the with the alien dead bodies and they would show these photographs.

plain: President Richard Nixon is said to have kept a folder in his filing cabinet holding photographs of dead alien bodies, which he would show to people. The researcher Grant Cameron repeats this story on the show and says he believes it is true. If so, it would mean a sitting president had direct proof of alien bodies close at hand.
